name: sparx — Veterinary (Modern)
tagline: A calm, fear-free template for modern vet practices — book online from day one.
description: A calm, modern veterinary-wellness site — a sage-and-cream palette, a refined serif display and soft, unhurried photography. Installs a working booking flow for fear-free care: real appointment types (wellness, nutrition, telehealth, senior), three vets you book by name plus two calm exam rooms as resources, and a wellness-plan policy. Ships as "Fauna Veterinary", a whole-pet, fear-free practice for dogs and cats.
